context: A dad jokes around with his young son after school
purpose: Teach: まとも/ヤツ/アレ/こいつ/トーク/いい加減/どうせ/カン

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: おかえりー！おっ、こいつ、また泥だらけじゃないか。
lines.en: Welcome home! Hey you, all covered in mud again, huh.
lines.style: Warm teasing dad voice, playful and bright with rising laugh at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、聞いて聞いて！今日ね、ケンタがアレやったの、アレ！
lines.en: Daddy, listen listen! Today Kenta did that thing, you know, that thing!
lines.style: Excited child rushing words together, high pitched and eager to share.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: アレって何だよ、まともに説明してくれよー。
lines.en: What do you mean 'that thing,' explain it properly to me!
lines.style: Mock-exasperated dad, drawn out vowels, laughing through the complaint.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えーっとね、給食のときヘンなヤツの真似してさ、面白かった！
lines.en: Umm, at lunch he imitated some weird guy, it was so funny!
lines.style: Child giggling between words, breathless and animated with little hiccups.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: はは、どうせまたパパのモノマネだろ？パパのカンでわかるぞー。
lines.en: Haha, bet it was an impression of me again, my dad senses tell me.
lines.style: Smug teasing dad, slow knowing tone, tapping his own forehead jokingly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ちがうもん！パパのトーク、いい加減つまんないし！
lines.en: It wasn't! Daddy your talking is honestly getting kind of boring!
lines.style: Pouty child protest, cheeky comeback, voice puffed up with mock indignation.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: なんだとー！いい加減にしろよ翔、パパ泣いちゃうぞ。
lines.en: What did you say! That's enough Sho, you'll make daddy cry!
lines.style: Fake-wounded dramatic dad, hand to chest energy, voice cracking on purpose.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ふふっ、どうせ泣かないくせにー。
lines.en: Heehee, you won't actually cry though, will you!
lines.style: Giggly child seeing through the bluff, sing-song teasing tone trailing off.
